answer: A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Pewter finisher alloy mark poured at the finishing bench is that proof, written out as each alloy is a pouring record witnessed by the master pewterer. One caught mask freezes the whole shelf's 185850 POA in stakes while the panel takes its time. The jetty opens the gate, the lantern pays the toll, the sonnet proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register.
